wargear.name: Carapace breastplate
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. Ceramite-laminate plate issued to Primes and officers who have earned it. The model's Save becomes 3+ if it was worse.

wargear.name: Bulwark field-cloak
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. A shimmering cloak woven with a cheap deflector mesh, worn by officers who expect to be shot at. The model's Invulnerable Save becomes 5+ if it was worse.

wargear.name: Veteran Prime
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. A Prime who has marched through three theatres and never lost a standard. The model gains +1 Ballistic Skill and +1 Leadership.

wargear.name: Cohort colours
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. The tercio's battle-honours, stitched into a banner that every trooper can see. Every model in the unit gains +1 Leadership and +1 Cool.

wargear.name: Charonite bastion-plate
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. Riveted slabs of charonite alloy bolted over an Ogryn's chest and shoulders. The model's Save becomes 3+ if it was worse.

wargear.name: Applique plating
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. Spare armour plate welded on in the field. The vehicle gains +1 Hull Point.

wargear.name: Siege plating
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. Thick glacis slabs and track skirts for crawling into a prepared line. The vehicle gains +1 Front armour, but loses 2" of Movement.

wargear.name: Fire-control cogitator
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. A cogitator rack that works out the arc before the gun is laid. The vehicle gains +1 Ballistic Skill.

option.text: The Sergeant may take a Carapace breastplate
The commander may take a Bulwark field-cloak
The Sergeant may be upgraded to a Veteran Prime
The Sergeant may carry a specialist weapon
Up to two Auxiliaries per ten may exchange their lasrifle for
One Veletarii in five may exchange their Volkite charger for
Up to two Veletarii in five may exchange their breaching shotgun for
Any Charonite ogryn may exchange their claws for
Any Charonite ogryn may be fitted with
The unit may carry its Cohort colours
May mount a Pintle-mounted lascarbine array

modifiers.text: Volley drill: +1 LD, -1 WS. Drilled to hold a line, not to fight on it.
Veteran tank crews: +1 BS, -1 Rear armour.

rules.name: Sealed Plate
rules.text: Legacy house rule (Void-Armoured Tercios). A unit with this rule is sealed against gas, flame and fear alike: it ignores Pinning (X) and Panic (X), and any Suppressive (X) effects against it are ignored.

rules.name: Spearhead Column
rules.text: Legacy house rule (The Armoured Fist). The tanks break from the line and drive deep before the foe has settled. A unit with this rule gains Outflank. On the first battle turn it may Rush and still fire one weapon at its full Ballistic Skill.

rules.name: Forward the Breakers
rules.text: Legacy house rule (Charonite Breaker Host). The Ogryn have one order and they have heard it. After both sides have deployed and before the first battle turn, a unit with this rule makes a free move of up to 6", ending no closer than 9" to any enemy model. On a turn it charges, it ignores Pinning (X) and Panic (X).

rules.name: Registered Fire
rules.text: Legacy house rule (The Ordnance Park). The park has ranged this ground for hours. If a unit with this rule did not move in its last Movement phase, it adds 1 to its Ballistic Skill, and re-rolls failed hit rolls against a unit another Registered Fire unit has already fired at this phase.

rules.name: Armoured Wave
rules.text: Legacy house rule (Dracosan Assault Wave). The Dracosans race ahead of the line and disgorge their cargo at the wall. A unit with this rule gains Outflank, and passengers may disembark from it after it has Rushed on the first battle turn and still declare a Charge that turn.

rites.name: Void-Armoured Tercios
rites.flavor: They crossed the dark between worlds in sealed plate, and they will cross a battlefield the same way.

modifiers.text: Void-Armoured Tercios: Line (1), Feel No Pain (6+), Sealed Plate.

require.note: The Rite needs at least two Veletaris Sections.

rites.text: They crossed the dark between worlds in sealed plate, and they will cross a battlefield the same way.
benefits: Veletaris Storm, Vanguard and Raider Sections may fill Troops slots and gain Line (1) and Feel No Pain (6+).
Those sections gain Sealed Plate: they ignore Pinning, Panic and Suppressive effects.
limitations: At least two Veletaris Sections are required.
No Charonite Ogryn Sections or Aethon Heavy Sentinels, and no Lord of War units.

rites.name: The Armoured Fist
rites.flavor: The infantry are there to hold the ground the tanks have just taken.

modifiers.text: The Armoured Fist: Line (1), Spearhead Column.

rites.text: The infantry are there to hold the ground the tanks have just taken.
benefits: Leman Russ, Malcador, Valdor, Destroyer and Thunderer tanks may fill Troops slots and gain Line (1).
Those tanks gain Outflank and Spearhead Column: on the first turn a tank may Rush and still fire one weapon at full Ballistic Skill.
limitations: At least three of those tanks are required.
No more than one Lasrifle Section, and no Veletaris Sections.

rites.name: Charonite Breaker Host
rites.flavor: The Ogryn do not understand tactics. They do understand the word 'forward'.

modifiers.text: Charonite Breaker Host: Fear (1), Forward the Breakers.

require.note: Bring at least one Charonite Ogryn Section.

rites.text: The Ogryn do not understand tactics. They do understand the word 'forward'.
benefits: Charonite Ogryn Sections may fill Troops slots and gain Fear (1).
They gain Forward the Breakers: a free 6" move before the first turn (not within 9" of the enemy), and they ignore Pinning and Panic on turns they charge.
limitations: At least one Charonite Ogryn Section is required.
No more than one tank from the Armour slots.
No Basilisk, Medusa or Rapier units and no Fast Attack units.
Table-top: a Charonite Ogryn Section that can charge must charge the nearest enemy unit it can reach.

rites.name: The Ordnance Park
rites.flavor: A regiment's real argument is made four kilometres behind its front line.

modifiers.condition: if the unit did not move in its last Movement phase

require.note: An Artillery Command Section directs the park.
At least two Basilisk, Medusa or Minotaur tanks.

rites.text: A regiment's real argument is made four kilometres behind its front line.
benefits: Basilisk and Medusa Artillery Tanks may fill Troops slots.

Basilisk, Medusa, Minotaur and Rapier units gain Registered Fire: +1 Ballistic Skill if they did not move, and re-rolled misses against a target another Registered Fire unit has already fired at that phase.
limitations: An Artillery Command Section and at least two Basilisk, Medusa or Minotaur tanks are required.
No Recon and no Fast Attack units.

rites.name: Dracosan Assault Wave
rites.flavor: Every tercio rides, and every Dracosan lands within a pistol-shot of the wall.

modifiers.text: Dracosan Assault Wave: +2 M, Assault Vehicle, Armoured Wave.

rites.text: Every tercio rides, and every Dracosan lands within a pistol-shot of the wall.
benefits: Dracosan Armoured Transports and Command Dracosans gain +2 Movement, Assault Vehicle and Outflank.
They gain Armoured Wave: on the first turn, passengers may disembark after the Dracosan Rushed and still charge.
limitations: At least two Dracosans are required.
No artillery tanks, no Rapier Sections and no Lord of War units.
Table-top: any Lasrifle or Veletaris Section that fits aboard a Dracosan must start the battle embarked.
